hooks.text: Astronomers catalogued a faint violet speck, assuming it was an ordinary star.
This faint violet dot outshines one hundred trillion Suns.
A faint photographic speck concealed forty billion Suns in one object.

title: The Faint Blue Star That Held 40 Billion Suns
description: In 1957, astronomers mistook TON 618 for an ordinary faint blue star. It turned out to be an ultramassive black hole tens of billions of times heavier than our Sun.

beats.text: Astronomers catalogued a faint violet speck, assuming it was an ordinary star.
beats.visual: Photographic plate showing faint blue stars from Tonantzintla Observatory, 1957

beats.text: In reality, TON 618 was an ultramassive black hole powered by a quasar 10.8 billion light-years away.
beats.visual: Artist concept of an active galactic nucleus and quasar, ESO, 2018

beats.text: Its event horizon radius spans approximately 1,300 astronomical units, swallowing the scale of our solar system.
beats.visual: Size comparison diagram of supermassive black hole event horizons and planetary orbits, 2019

beats.text: Gas whipping around its core exceeds orbital speeds of 10,000 kilometers per second.
beats.visual: Simulation of relativistic gas accretion disk around a spinning black hole, NASA, 2019
queries: Black hole accretion disk simulation NASA

beats.text: That infalling material unleashes a brilliance equal to 140 trillion Suns, completely drowning out its host galaxy.
beats.visual: Artist illustration of an extraordinarily luminous quasar outshining its galaxy, NASA, 2020

beats.text: Early measurements estimated 66 billion solar masses, later revised to roughly 40.7 billion Suns.
beats.visual: Hubble Space Telescope optical spectrum observation of a distant quasar, 2015

beats.text: Surrounding it all is an enormous Lyman-alpha gas nebula spanning at least 100 kiloparsecs across.
beats.visual: Artist impression of a gigantic Lyman-alpha gas halo surrounding a quasar, ESO, 2016

beats.text: No singular monster in the cosmos has ever hidden behind such a quiet disguise.
beats.visual: Deep wide-field view of the constellation Canes Venatici showing distant stars, 2021
queries: Canes Venatici constellation stars wide field
